args.stdin: WITH store AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Ljubljana' AND store_name LIKE '%central%hardware%branch%'), descriptions(brand, series, prop_key, prop_val) AS (VALUES ('Heco', 'Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw', 'screw_type', 'drywall screw'), ('Festool', 'Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag', 'storage_type', 'tool bag'), ('Festool', 'Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag', 'storage_type', 'parts case'), ('Ajax', 'Ajax Eco Classic 25C-DXE Cleaning Liquid', 'cleaner_type', 'floor cleaner'), ('Ajax', 'Ajax Eco Classic 25C-DXE Cleaning Liquid', 'cleaner_type', 'degreaser')), products AS (SELECT d.brand, d.series, d.prop_key, d.prop_val, CASE WHEN pvp.product_sku IS NOT NULL THEN pv.product_sku ELSE NULL END AS product_sku FROM descriptions d LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.brand = d.brand AND pv.series = d.series LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = d.prop_key AND pvp.property_value_text = d.prop_val), inventory AS (SELECT p.product_sku, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS qty FROM products p LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p.product_sku) SELECT (SELECT store_id FROM store) AS store_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_sku IS NOT NULL) AS product_skus_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE qty >= 2) AS count_ge2;
